courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 岩體節理剪力試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「沉陷槽形與參數」與「地下水下降與固結」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；岩體節理剪力試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Settlement-trough geometry" and "Drawdown and consolidation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rock-joint shear testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響；岩體節理剪力試驗則以以法向條件、粗糙峰破壞與位移歷程區分節理峰值和殘餘抗剪為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation; Rock-joint shear testing centres on separate peak and residual joint resistance through normal boundaries, asperity damage and displacement history, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「沉陷槽形與參數」與「法向應力與摩擦」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到岩體節理剪力試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「速率與排水時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Settlement-trough geometry” and “Normal stress and friction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rock-joint shear testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rate and drainage time", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 隧道收斂量測
related.transfer: 可遷移「沉陷槽形與參數」與「地下水下降與固結」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道收斂量測的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Settlement-trough geometry" and "Drawdown and consolidation" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel convergence monitoring must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響；隧道收斂量測則以用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation; Tunnel convergence monitoring centres on identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「沉陷槽形與參數」與「收斂弦長與方向」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道收斂量測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「支護接觸與剛度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Settlement-trough geometry” and “Convergence chords and direction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel convergence monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Support contact and stiffness", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道地表沉陷監測
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
